usedFor: Aiso follows how a brand shows up in AI assistants, and “Create Project” sets up tracking for a domain.

bestTemplate.name: “Create Project” in Aiso
bestTemplate.why: It starts a project for a domain, and Aiso analyzes the domain and returns its setup.

watchOut: Aiso has no trigger here, so AI agents call “Create Project” on a schedule or when you ask them.
